message.riseofempires.job.none: %s: "Then I will rest my hands until you need them."
message.riseofempires.job.farmer: %s: "The fields, then. I will cut what is ripe, sow again and bring the harvest to the granary."
message.riseofempires.job.builder: %s: "I will build. Keep the granary stocked and I will raise whatever you have laid out."
message.riseofempires.job.gatherer: %s: "I will gather wood and stone near the camp and bring it in."
message.riseofempires.builder.missing: %1$s: "The granary has no %2$s. I cannot go on until some is stored."
message.riseofempires.builder.no_store: %1$s: "%2$s has no granary with a chest to take materials from. I cannot build."
